display.purpose: Bungee poster type. Section headline stickers and CTA labels only — always inside a sticker or a button. Also used unstickered at smaller sizes for venue/accommodation/schedule names.

body.purpose: Archivo Black, flat and functional. Sub-heads and short card copy. One heavy weight only; do not run long.

label.purpose: Archivo Black, 0.65-0.8rem, uppercase, letter-spaced. Info tags, badges, nav links, headings, time chips, attributions. Often at 0.45-0.55 opacity for secondary labels.

quote.purpose: Kalam 700. Captions, pull-quotes, checklist items, testimonial quotes. Set in note-blue (#2d52c8 / #1e3a6e) when it sits on 'paper'.

shadows.name: sticker-sm
shadows.purpose: Badges, small chips, social discs, tight card treatments.

shadows.name: sticker-md
shadows.purpose: Default for stickers, white outlined cards, feature cards.

shadows.name: sticker-xl
shadows.purpose: Polaroids and the video modal box — the heaviest objects.

shadows.name: press-collapse
shadows.purpose: Hover/active state of the primary button — shadow shrinks as the button translates into it.

shadows.name: press-collapse-sm
shadows.purpose: Hover/active state of small controls (header CTA, scroll arrows, modal close).

shadows.name: torn-paper-drop
shadows.purpose: Follows the irregular silhouette of the notebook-paper and clipboard PNGs.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The only motion in the system. On hover/active, a control translates by translate(4px,4px) (2px for small controls) while its shadow collapses to match — physically pressed into the page.

motion.name: header-collapse
motion.purpose: Desktop-only (>=1101px): the fixed header shrinks 80px -> 50px once the page is scrolled.

outlines.name: outline-thick
outlines.purpose: The standard object frame — stickers, buttons, white cards, polaroids. Drawn just inside the edge.

outlines.name: outline-thin
outlines.purpose: Lighter frame — info tags, badge pills, icon and social discs.

gutters.note: Deliberately asymmetric (wide punched-margin bias); the hero and footer override to symmetric 80/80.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled button on the site. Yellow means clickable.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; padding: 16px 36px; background: #facc15; color: #1b1533; outline: 4px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -4px; box-shadow: 7px 7px 0 #1b1533; font-family: 'Bungee', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 80ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1b1533; transform: translate(4px, 4px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #1b1533; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #facc15, 7px 7px 0 #1b1533; }

components.name: Header CTA (small)
components.description: Compact primary button for the header bar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-sm { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; background: #facc15; color: #1b1533; outline: 4px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -4px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1b1533; font-family: 'Bungee', sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 80ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary-sm:hover { box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #1b1533; transform: translate(2px, 2px); }

components.name: Newsletter Ghost Button
components.description: Hollow twin of the primary button. Outlined, never filled, so yellow stays the only button colour. Lives on the teal footer.
components.html: Sign up for our newsletter
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; padding: 15px 30px; background: transparent; outline: 3px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: -3px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1b1533; font-family: 'Bungee', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 80ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #1b1533; transform: translate(4px, 4px); }

components.name: Sticker Headline
components.description: Signature component. Each headline line is its own puffy sticker — pink, teal, or orange, never yellow. Lines stack with a 12px gap, each slightly rotated.
components.css: .ds-sticker { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 16px; outline: 4px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -4px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1b1533; font-family: 'Bungee', sans-serif; font-size: 3rem; line-height: 1.1; color: #ffffff; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-sticker--teal { background: #14b8a6; } .ds-sticker--pink { background: #f43f5e; transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-sticker--orange { background: #f97316; }

components.name: Info Tag
components.description: Small rectangular metadata tag — location, date, duration. Hard corners, inset outline, no shadow.
components.html: Cape Town Feb 12th 2027 3 Nights
components.css: .ds-info-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px; outline: 2.5px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -2.5px; font-family: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-info-tag--pink { background: #f43f5e; } .ds-info-tag--teal { background: #14b8a6; } .ds-info-tag--orange { background: #f97316; }

components.name: Badge Pill
components.description: Rounded status callout, e.g. "30% sold out". The only pill-shaped element besides discs.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f97316; outline: 2.5px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -2.5px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1b1533; font-family: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #ffffff; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }

components.name: Outlined Card
components.description: The white feature/quote card. Hard corners, 4px inset ink outline, flat medium shadow. No hover change.
components.html:
✓

All food & drinks

Every meal, every snack, every drink. You never reach for your wallet at Camp.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 14px; max-width: 320px; background: #ffffff; padding: 28px 26px; outline: 4px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -4px; box-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #1b1533; } .ds-card__icon { width: 52px; height: 52px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #14b8a6; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 50%; outline: 2.5px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -2.5px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #1b1533; font-family: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; } .ds-card__title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #1b1533; } .ds-card__text { margin: 0; font-family: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #1b1533; }

components.name: Polaroid
components.description: White photo mat with a wide chin for a handwritten caption. Heaviest shadow in the system; always rotated a few degrees.
components.css: .ds-polaroid { display: inline-block; margin: 0; background: #ffffff; padding: 20px 20px 80px; outline: 4px solid #1b1533; outline-offset: -4px; box-shadow: 9px 9px 0 #1b1533; transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-polaroid__frame { width: 240px; height: 200px; background: #d4d4d4; overflow: hidden; } .ds-polaroid__caption { font-family: 'Kalam', cursive; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #2d52c8; text-align: center; margin-top: 12px; line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: Header Nav Link
components.description: Plain uppercase text link. Never a pill or sticker. Dim at rest, full ink on hover; active link carries an orange hard rule.
components.html: HomeRankingsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 26px; } .ds-nav__link { font-family: 'Archivo Black', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #1b1533; opacity: 0.45; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; padding-bottom: 2px; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-nav__link:hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav__link--active { opacity: 1; border-bottom-color: #f97316; }

narrative.overview: The page is not a website about camp — it is the scrapbook someone assembled after they got home: photos pinned down, captions written in pen, stickers and torn notebook paper stuck to the sheet with a glue stick, circa 1996. Every element is a discrete physical object with its own weight, its own hand-placed tilt, and one hard-edged shadow proving it sits a few millimetres above the page. Nothing looks generated in software, and that is the whole point. The energy comes from density and colour — chunky poster type, four loud hues, objects overlapping at angles — but the restraint is what keeps it a scrapbook and not a mess: a tight palette, hard 90 degree corners almost everywhere, no soft gradients, no blur, and a page paced as a stack of paper sheets where only two of them are allowed to shout in full colour. Motion is currently minimal — a single tactile press on interactive controls — and is an open area for future work, welcome as long as it doesn't undermine the cut-and-glued, hard-edged feel. Confirmed anti-references: anything that looks designed in a computer — soft drop shadows, blurred glass, smooth gradients, rounded-everything cards.
keyCharacteristics: Every placed object casts one flat, zero-blur offset shadow in ink.
Four accent hues (pink, teal, orange, yellow) over three neutrals (cream, ink-navy, white); yellow is controls only.
Borders are inset outlines drawn just inside the edge, not `border`.
Hard 90 degree corners everywhere except stickers (16px) and pills/discs (999px).
Objects are hand-rotated -4 to +4 degrees and vertically nudged so rows read as placed by hand.
The page is a stack of paper sheets: each section gets either a soft wash or a hard-edged pattern, never both; exactly two carry a full teal colour field.
Three type voices with fixed jobs: Bungee (poster), Archivo Black (functional), Kalam (handwriting).

rules.name: The Yellow-Is-A-Verb Rule
rules.body: Yellow (#facc15) appears only on things you can click. It never goes on a sticker, a tag, or a badge. Break this and yellow stops meaning "press here".

rules.name: The Two-Loud-Sheets Rule
rules.body: At most two sections on a page carry a full teal colour field (currently the Julie quote and Everything's Included). Everything else is cream or a wash. The page is paced around those two payoffs.

rules.name: The One-Or-The-Other Rule
rules.body: A section gets either a soft wash or a hard-edged pattern (halftone, barber stripe, ledger grid, contour lines). Never both, and never a soft gradient — every pattern is built from hard colour stops.

rules.name: The Three-Voices Rule
rules.body: Bungee = poster, Archivo Black = machine label, Kalam = a person's handwriting. A piece of text picks exactly one voice for exactly its job. No blending.

rules.name: The Short-Copy Rule
rules.body: Body text is Archivo Black, which is all weight and no air. Keep it to a couple of lines; if a paragraph wants to run long, that is a content problem, not a reason to switch to a lighter weight.

rules.name: The Zero-Blur Rule
rules.body: No shadow in the system has a blur radius. Ever. box-shadow is always Npx Npx 0. The one blur in the codebase is the hero's two 100px-blur colour blobs at 0.25 opacity, which are background atmosphere behind a halftone and never touch a foreground object — treat that as the sealed exception, not a precedent.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: On :hover / :active, an interactive control shrinks its shadow (to 3px or 1px) and translates by the same offset (translate(4px,4px) / translate(2px,2px)) over 80ms — the object is physically pressed into the page.

rules.name: The Edges-Have-No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The sticky header and the footer get a hard 3px ink rule and no shadow. They are the top and bottom edges of the paper, not objects on top of it; a shadow there would drag across every section on scroll.

dos: Do give every placed object exactly one hard offset shadow in ink-navy from the 3 / 6 / 7 / 9px set — always Npx Npx 0, never with blur.
Do draw borders as outline with a negative outline-offset (4px / 2.5px solid ink), so the line sits just inside the edge.
Do keep Control Yellow (#facc15) exclusively on things you can click.
Do hand-rotate repeated objects -4 to +4 degrees and vary their vertical nudge (via nth-child) so rows read as placed by hand.
Do build every section background from hard colour stops — halftone dots, barber stripes, ledger grid, contour lines — and give a section either a wash or a pattern, never both.
Do keep the two full teal colour fields as the page's only loud sheets, and pace the layout around them.
Do set headlines in a sticker (Bungee, 16px radius, inset outline, hard shadow) and nowhere else; use Kalam 700 for captions, quotes, and checklist voice.
Do collapse a control's shadow and translate it by the same offset on hover/active (80ms) so it feels pressed.
donts: Don't add a blur radius to any shadow, or a soft gradient to any fill. The hero blobs are the one sealed exception.
Don't put yellow on a sticker, tag, or badge.
Don't make nav links into pills, tags, or stickers — they are plain uppercase text.
Don't give the sticky header or footer a shadow; they get a hard 3px rule only.
Don't use a dark colour as a section background — only the venue info panel and the video modal interior are dark.
Don't round the corners of cards, tags, polaroids, or photo frames; radius belongs to stickers (16px) and pills/discs (999px) only.
Don't introduce a fifth accent hue, and don't set long paragraphs in Archivo Black — keep body copy brief.
